assets.caption: EXHIBIT 12-3: Stairway Dimensional Detail. Two-panel engineering drawing. Left panel shows a side-elevation view of an inclined stairway with handrails, indicating an overall vertical dimension labeled approximately 2'-6". Right panel shows an end-elevation view of the same stairway showing tread spacing dimensions labeled "2'-6" - 5'-0"" and ".760 - .815" (tread spacing in feet-inches and meters).
